power_policy: hybrid steering + digital ZF, total precoder norm=column
nonlinear_processing: BS per-antenna time-domain OFDM symbol is clipped before cyclic prefix insertion
symbol_power: E[|s_u|^2] = 1 for QAM data and active pilots
precoder: MATLAB-style analog steering beams from the strongest SCM path, followed by per-subcarrier digital ZF on Wr.T @ H_tx_est @ Wt
noise_power: complex per-antenna variance sigma2; generated as sqrt(sigma2/2)*(n_re+j*n_im)
snr_definition: sigma2 = mean(|raw received data waveform before AWGN|^2) / 10^(snr_db/10)

rf_impairments.location: receiver front-end, after multipath channel and before AWGN
rf_impairments.default_policy: enabled by default for RF stress testing; use the True WL-H -> WL-MMSE receiver metric as a true-channel linear reference
rf_impairments.mild_stress_test_example: 0.5 dB I/Q gain imbalance, 3 degree I/Q phase error, 5 degree common phase rotation
rf_impairments.nonzero_warning: I/Q imbalance is a widely-linear RF impairment. With nonzero RF impairment, A_eff_true remains the pre-RF linear effective channel, so plain True-H and LMMSE channel-estimation baselines are no longer true-channel references.

test_snr_policy: paired base frames: test_snr*.npz files share the same channel, bits, precoder, clean data waveform, and clean pilot waveform per frame; only AWGN scale changes by SNR
receiver_compatibility: raw UE antenna-domain waveform; use rx_mumimo_receiver.py
